items.source: Making a BeanFactory available is optional; if not set, SchedulingConfigurer beans won't get autodetected and a scheduler has to be explicitly configured.

items.source: Autodetects any SchedulingConfigurer instances in the container, allowing for customization of the scheduler to be used or for fine-grained control over task registration (for example, registration of Trigger tasks). See the @EnableScheduling javadocs for complete usage details.
items.translation: 自动检测容器中的任何 `SchedulingConfigurer` 实例， 允许自定义要使用的调度器，或对任务注册进行细粒度控制（例如，注册 `Trigger` 任务）。 有关完整的使用详情，请参阅 `@EnableScheduling` 的 JavaDoc。

items.source: If not specified, default scheduler resolution will apply: searching for a unique TaskScheduler bean in the context, or for a TaskScheduler bean named "taskScheduler" otherwise; the same lookup will also be performed for a ScheduledExecutorService bean. If neither of the two is resolvable, a local single-threaded default scheduler will be created within the registrar.
items.translation: 如果未指定，将应用默认调度器解析度：在上下文中搜索唯一的TaskSchedulerBean，或者（否则）搜索名为 "taskScheduler" 的TaskSchedulerBean；还将执行相同的查找以获取一个ScheduledExecutorServiceBean。如果这两个 Bean 均无法解析，则在注册器中创建一个本地单线程默认调度器。

items.source: This post-processor is automatically registered by Spring's <task:annotation-driven> XML element and also by the @EnableScheduling annotation.
items.translation: 此后置处理器由 Spring 的 `` XML 元素自动注册，同时也由`@EnableScheduling`注解自动注册。

items.source: The default implementation creates a ScheduledMethodRunnable.
items.translation: 默认实现会创建一个ScheduledMethodRunnable。

items.source: The default implementation returns the given bean as-is.
items.translation: 默认实现原样返回给定的bean。

items.source:
Note that the initial lookup happens by type; this is just the fallback
in case of multiple scheduler beans found in the context.
items.translation: 请注意，初始查找是按类型进行的；这只是在上下文中找到多个调度器 Bean 时的后备方案。

items.source:
Note that this includes upcoming scheduled subscriptions for reactive
methods but doesn't cover any currently active subscription for such methods.
items.translation: 注意，这包括反应式方法的即将安排的计划订阅，但不涵盖此类方法当前任何活跃的订阅。

items.source: Return all currently scheduled tasks, from Scheduled methods as well as from programmatic SchedulingConfigurer interaction.
items.translation: 返回所有当前已安排的任务，包括来自 `Scheduled` 方法以及程序化 `SchedulingConfigurer` 交互的任务。

items.source: NOTE: This callback won't be triggered for singleton beans lazily initialized on demand after BeanFactory bootstrap, and not for any other bean scope either. Carefully use it for beans with the intended bootstrap semantics only.
items.translation: 注意：此回调不会为在 BeanFactory 引导后按需懒式初始化的单例 Bean 触发，也不会为任何其他 Bean 作用域触发。请仅针对具有预期引导语义的 Bean 谨慎使用它。

items.source: This callback will also be invoked after a short-circuiting triggered by a InstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor.postProcessBeforeInstantiation(Class, String) method, in contrast to all other BeanPostProcessor callbacks.
items.translation: 此回调也会在由InstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor.postProcessBeforeInstantiation(Class, String)方法触发的短路之后被调用，这与所有其他BeanPostProcessor回调不同。

items.source: The default implementation returns true. If a pre-5 implementation of DestructionAwareBeanPostProcessor does not provide a concrete implementation of this method, Spring silently assumes true as well.
items.translation: 默认实现返回true。如果 5 版本之前的实现未提供此方法的具象实现，Spring 也会静默地假设其为true。

items.source: Invoked after population of normal bean properties but before an init callback such as InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet() or a custom init-method.
items.translation: 在普通 Bean 属性填充之后、但在初始化回调（如InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet()）或自定义 init-method 之前调用。

items.source: Higher values are interpreted as lower priority. As a consequence, the object with the lowest value has the highest priority (somewhat analogous to Servlet load-on-startup values).
items.translation: 较高的值被解释为较低的优先级。因此，具有最低值的对象具有最高的优先级（类似于 Servlet 的 `load-on-startup` 值）。

items.source: In case of a FactoryBean, this callback will be invoked for both the FactoryBean instance and the objects created by the FactoryBean. The post-processor can decide whether to apply to either the FactoryBean or created objects or both through corresponding bean instanceof FactoryBean checks.
items.translation: 对于 FactoryBean，此回调将针对 FactoryBean 实例以及由 FactoryBean 创建的对象均被调用。后处理器可以通过相应的 `bean instanceof FactoryBean` 检查来决定是应用于 FactoryBean、创建的对象还是两者。

items.source: Like DisposableBean's destroy and a custom destroy method, this callback will only apply to beans which the container fully manages the lifecycle for. This is usually the case for singletons and scoped beans.
items.translation: 与 `DisposableBean` 的 `destroy` 方法和自定义销毁方法类似，此回调仅适用于容器完全管理生命周期的 Bean。通常，单例和作用域 Bean 都属于这种情况。

items.translation: 相同的顺序值将导致受影响的对象具有任意的排序位置。
